predict.question: Budget 40 bytes; frames contain 6 payload plus 4 extra. How much payload fits?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Redundancy trades transmission capacity for protection against communication errors.
modelBoundary: Less redundancy carries {A}; more carries {B}. Every frame spends more of its fixed budget on extra bytes, leaving fewer payload bytes.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This shows capacity cost only. It supplies no error channel, decoder or evidence that these extra bytes correct errors.
